leakscan.why: the publication guard (tools/guard.py) names the IPv6 documentation range 2001:db8::/32 as the one range it accepts, so its own docstring and messages read as IPv6 addresses to a structural scanner. The guard's local check below gates IP addresses more strictly than leakscan's shapes, passing only documentation ranges (RFC 3849, RFC 5737)

guard.why: PageKit's own publication guard: no address, host name, email address or GUID outside the reserved and documentation ranges, and no term from a contributor's own denylist, in any tracked file. FORBIDS THE ACT: a public history cannot be recalled

extra-hook.why: a contributor's own pre-commit check, named in their clone's git config as pagekit.extraHook and kept outside the repository; passes when none is set
